title: Address-to-lot identity honesty (DB-026): GeoSearch equality gate + typed no-match + confirm-arc address-of-record display
objective: Close the DB-026 identity gap in the LIVE address arc: (1) the web GeoSearch client (apps/web/src/lib/address-search.ts) currently trusts the top /search feature, but the captured corpus proves GeoSearch returns a plausible WRONG lot for nonsense input at identical confidence/match_type (fallback/0.8 on the true hit AND on garbage) - add the EQUALITY GATE: a feature counts as a match ONLY when its returned housenumber and normalized street equal the parsed input (documented normalization per the corpus: '37th'->'37'); match on addendum.pad.bbl, never on address-string or bin; a gate failure is a typed honest no-match (never a silently wrong lot); never gate on match_type/confidence; /autocomplete features omit those two keys entirely - the parser must tolerate their absence; (2) surface the resolved lot identity honestly on the confirm arc: entered input vs matched city address, BBL, and the lot's PLUTO address-of-record when it differs (the corner-lot case: entered '1279 37th Street' -> lot 3052960043 whose record address is '3622 13 AVENUE') as a RECORDS display (D-073-R006 class), using EXISTING data channels only - NO contract-shape change; (3) pin the case-1 regression offline: the captured corpus drives tests proving the true hit passes the gate, the GARAGE sibling and reverse frontage resolve to the same lot, and both failure probes (wrong-street, wrong-housenumber) are REFUSED by the gate; (4) author the GeoSearch source-registry draft record mirroring the committed shape. Geoclient server path (already integrated, M2-T021) is OUT of scope
business_reason: The corpus proves a user typing a nonexistent address today can be silently landed on a real but WRONG lot - an identity-integrity hazard in the live product; DB-026's case-1 (corner-lot frontage) is the recorded live stop

SCOPE 1/2 - THE EQUALITY GATE (binding; read docs/research/db026-address-to-lot-fixture-capture.md sections 1-5 + assertions 1-4, and docs/research/db026-address-to-lot-source-recon.md first): the captured corpus proves /search returns confidence:0.8, match_type:'fallback' IDENTICALLY on the true hit, on a nonexistent street (returns a real WRONG lot), and on an out-of-range house number (returns a different house number) - and never an empty features array for these probes. In apps/web/src/lib/address-search.ts: (a) a /search feature counts as a MATCH only when its returned properties.housenumber equals the parsed input house number AND its normalized street equals the parsed input street (normalization documented against the corpus: '37th street'->'37 STREET'; define and test the ordinal/case rule; treat the corpus's parsed_text as the reference parse); (b) a feature failing the gate yields the EXISTING typed no-match outcome (the M5-T032 outcome vocabulary - extend honestly if a new distinction is needed, never overload), never a silently wrong lot; (c) lot identity binds to addendum.pad.bbl (never the address string or bin - the GARAGE sibling and reverse frontage are the same lot, different features); (d) match_type/confidence are RECORDED if already surfaced but never used as a success test; (e) /autocomplete features OMIT confidence and match_type entirely - the parser must tolerate their absence (corpus section 5); (f) suggestions (autocomplete) may stay permissive - the GATE applies where a single feature is promoted to THE resolved lot for analysis/confirm.

SCOPE 2/2 - DISPLAY + REGISTRY (binding): (g) confirm-arc identity honesty (D-073-R006 records class) on address/AddressConfirmCard.tsx / AddressResolutionScreen.tsx: show the entered input verbatim and the matched city address; when the matched frontage differs from the lot's PLUTO address-of-record AND that record address is available through an EXISTING data channel, show it as a record ('city record address: 3622 13 AVENUE') - if no existing channel carries it, ship the entered-vs-matched increment and report the record-address channel gap as a DISCOVERY (do NOT add a server endpoint or contract field); records stay records - no computed value is implied by any address line; (h) the case-1 regression pinned offline from the corpus: true hit passes the gate; '37th' variant matches ('37 STREET'); GARAGE + reverse frontage resolve to the same bbl 3052960043; the two failure probes are REFUSED with the typed no-match (assert NO lot is surfaced); (i) author docs/research/source-registry-drafts/geosearch.json mirroring the committed ztldb.json shape (endpoints /search + /autocomplete, addendum.pad.{bbl,bin,version} path, the body-only freshness stamp addendum.pad.version='26c', the no-Last-Modified header finding, the equality-gate requirement as the documented match discipline).

PRESERVATION (binding): the M5-T032 reliability outcomes (503/429/timeout/no-match/malformed, bounded retry, preserved input) stay byte-identical for their existing cases; the autocomplete suggestion UX stays permissive; no new dependency; no npm/package.json change; NO contract-shape change; NO services/api change; the Geoclient server path untouched; a11y intact on touched components (existing aria patterns).

Discovery routing (D-069): surface out-of-scope findings in your report; never fix them in-packet. No WebFetch (network default-deny; fixtures come from the captured corpus verbatim). Thin client: no local npm/node.

[ORCH-SCOPE-ADJUDICATION 2026-09-19, pre-submit, option A] The run-10 producer established with call-path evidence (report section 5, verified against source at the material head) that the packet's premise was WRONG at HEAD: the web client NEVER promotes a GeoSearch feature to THE lot - suggestions structurally discard pad.bbl and stay permissive, and the only lot authority is the server Geoclient route (out of scope by design). There is therefore NO unsafe live GeoSearch promotion to protect. ADJUDICATION: (1) deliverables 1-4 (equality-gate library + corpus regression + geosearch registry draft + the LIVE confirm-arc entered-vs-matched display with raw typed-input preservation) ARE this packet's contracted deliverable; (2) NO new client-side GeoSearch lot-promotion or degraded-mode authority path is introduced - the server-Geoclient-mediated resolution is recorded as the live lot authority; (3) the equality-gate library + the registry draft's match discipline are BINDING on any FUTURE packet that introduces a GeoSearch promotion (the gate must be its guard - recorded in the geosearch.json registry draft and DB-026's closure note); (4) AS-1/AS-4 are satisfied at the library level driven by the byte-faithful corpus (their protective claim attaches to the promotion path that does not exist at HEAD). The live-protection objective is thus resolved by adjudication, not narrowed silently.
